title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-02-13
lineage: SBD > MR > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard recording of the legendary 2/13‑70 show, highlighted by an epic Dark Star → The Other One marathon and a soaring Turn On Your Love Light.
ai_review.review: The archive capture delivers superb, stereo soundboard quality that many reviewers call album‑ready (with only minor complaints about low‑frequency depth). Musically the concert is revered for its 60‑minute Dark Star into The Other One sequence, plus a blistering Turn On Your Love Light and an inspiring acoustic set. Overall the performance is described as one of the all‑time great Dead shows.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly positive, detailed reviews praise both the audio fidelity and the historic, high‑energy performance; only a few low‑star comments relate to site policy rather than the show itself.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, stereo mix described as album‑ready and crystal‑clear; some listeners note a slight loss of low‑frequency depth compared with other copies but no major dropouts or distortion.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A strong electric opening, a beautiful acoustic interlude (partially released on Bear's Choice), then an unforgettable second set capped by the monumental Dark Star → The Other One suite and a high‑energy Turn On Your Love Light.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers praise Jerry Garcia’s inventive lead, noting his tone and how he drives the epic Dark Star and The Other One.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob Weir is highlighted for driving the band through a high‑energy Other One performance.
